plain.label: Completed 200: find projects
plain.summary: GET /api/projects/p1 → route /api/projects/:id 200 → server getProject → db find projects (handler: getProject) [completed 200]

fetch_self.label: Completed 200: update projects
fetch_self.summary: POST /api/projects/p1/archive → route /api/projects/:id/archive 200 → server archiveProject → db update projects (handler: archiveProject) → outbound POST /internal/notify (from handler archiveProject) → server /internal/notify 201 → handler notify → db insert notifications (handler: notify) [completed 200]

http_peer_nested.label: Responded 200: no write observed
http_peer_nested.summary: POST /api/projects/p1/sync → route /api/projects/:id/sync 200 → server syncProject → hop 1: outbound POST /peer/relay (from handler syncProject) → server outbound-peer /peer/relay 200 → handler relay; hop 1.1: outbound GET /internal/ping/p1 (from handler relay) → server outbound-main /internal/ping/:id 200 → handler ping → db find projects (handler: ping) [responded 200; no write observed]

frontiers.label: Completed 202: insert webhook_attempts; a further server-side hop may have escaped
escaped: outbound POST http://127.0.0.1:PORT/hooks/project-archived 200 (from handler sendWebhook) → no incoming span for this traceparent (not instrumented, or not reached); also possible: the app replaced the traceparent after the request was created, or a second OpenTelemetry SDK sent another one

outbound POST http://127.0.0.1:PORT/hooks/mirror (from handler sendWebhook) → no response (connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:PORT); no incoming span for this traceparent (not instrumented, or not reached)
frontiers.summary: POST /api/projects/p1/webhook → route /api/projects/:id/webhook 202 → server sendWebhook → db insert webhook_attempts (handler: sendWebhook) → hop 1: outbound POST http://127.0.0.1:PORT/hooks/project-archived 200 (from handler sendWebhook) → no incoming span for this traceparent (not instrumented, or not reached); also possible: the app replaced the traceparent after the request was created, or a second OpenTelemetry SDK sent another one; hop 2: outbound POST http://127.0.0.1:PORT/hooks/mirror (from handler sendWebhook) → no response (connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:PORT); no incoming span for this traceparent (not instrumented, or not reached) [completed 202; a further server-side hop may have escaped]

chain_depth.label: Completed 200: insert chain_ends (hop 1.1.1.1.1: POST /api/chain/0)
chain_depth.summary: POST /api/chain/5 → route /api/chain/:depth 200 → server chainStep → hop 1: outbound POST /api/chain/4 (from handler chainStep) → server /api/chain/:depth 200 → handler chainStep; hop 1.1: outbound POST /api/chain/3 (from handler chainStep) → server /api/chain/:depth 200 → handler chainStep; hop 1.1.1: outbound POST /api/chain/2 (from handler chainStep) → server /api/chain/:depth 200 → handler chainStep; +2 more hops (2 deeper than 3) (see hops) [completed 200]
